figurative_meaning_en: Something inedible or worthless, nothing at all, a deception or trick
similar_in_english: The short end of the stick
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই চাকরিটা তো কচুপোড়ার মতো, কোনো লাভ নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: My luck has only brought me burnt taro.
This job is like burnt taro—utterly worthless.
note: Refers to the inedible state of burnt colocasia root, symbolizing misfortune in everyday Bengali rural life.
